# Install, Docs and Site Page Requirements Quality Checklist: Versioned Plug-in ABIs (spec 037)

**Purpose**: Are install contents, guides, version-history documentation and the Hugo plug-in author page fully required and checkable?
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ read for cross-checks)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Install

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact installed header set required in the spec (the four ABI headers, the convention header `orplugin.h`, its C++ wrapper `orplugin.hpp`), given dsply.h and the others include orplugin.h? [Gap, Spec §FR-026, §SC-011; plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK002 Is the new installed library (`libRIBShadeop`, shared and static) and its export in the package targets required by the spec (it is only a plan/research decision)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012; research Q1]
- [x] CHK003 Is the installed include path stability stated for headers moved within the tree (`shadeop.h`, `dlo.h`, `implicit.h` keep their installed names)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK004 Is "the install list names exactly the headers installed" defined against a single source of truth (CMake install rules, manifest, INSTALL_ARTIFACTS.md)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-011, §US8-2]
- [x] CHK005 Is the scratch-prefix build of the guide's example display requirement platform-neutral (FHS vs self-contained layouts)? [Coverage, Spec §US8-1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the impact on libraries that other consumers link (compiler, shading) and on `OPENRENDER_COMPAT_SOVERSION` addressed? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
